title: Author the book figure proof set with provenance labels and the methodology figure rule
acceptance_criteria: Three to four figures are authored: one book-level placement/ownership structure figure, one adapted existing sequence from Studies 02/03, one new Study 05 stale-fill sequence, and optionally one lifecycle/expiry figure

Each figure carries two independent labels - form (structure/sequence/state) and evidence status (conceptual illustration / implemented design contract / negative control / observed result) - plus an adjacent text equivalent
An observed-result figure cites an active evidence claim; no figure embeds a performance number, ratio or causal performance claim
The two-reader check is run and recorded, and each figure is kept, redesigned or dropped on that basis; a figure that adds no comprehension is removed rather than shipped
A figure-evidence rule is added to docs/methodology.md stating that an illustration is never evidence and an observed result cites a registered claim
The PDF rebuilds with every figure source and embedded asset covered by the build manifest
validation: HIGH review confirms each arrow and entity maps to the named design revision
Two-reader check recorded, including any figure dropped for failing it
